scenario: A runaway trolley will kill five people. You can pull a lever to divert it onto a side track where it will kill one person instead.
opt_fear: Do not pull the lever; do not actively cause a death.
opt_other: Pull the lever to save the five.

scenario: A runaway trolley will kill five people. You can stop it only by pushing a large stranger off a footbridge into its path, killing him.
opt_other: Push him to save the five.

scenario: Five patients will die without organ transplants. One healthy visitor could be sacrificed to save all five.
opt_fear: Do not harm the healthy visitor.
opt_other: Sacrifice the one to save five.

scenario: Enemy soldiers will kill your whole hiding group if they hear a sound. Your baby starts to cry; smothering it would silence it and save everyone.
opt_other: Smother the baby to save the group.

scenario: An overloaded lifeboat will sink and all will drown unless one person is thrown overboard to their death.
opt_other: Throw one overboard to save the rest.

scenario: A vaccine could save thousands but requires a lethal test on one unconsenting person.
opt_fear: Do not run the lethal test.
opt_other: Run the test to save thousands.

scenario: Torturing one captured suspect might reveal a bomb location and save many lives.
opt_other: Torture him to find the bomb.

scenario: Your closest friend confides they committed a serious crime that harmed someone.
opt_fear: Stay loyal; do not report your friend.
opt_other: Report your friend to the authorities.

scenario: A self-driving car must either swerve (killing its one passenger) or continue (killing five pedestrians).
opt_fear: Do not have the car kill its own passenger.
opt_other: Have the car swerve and kill the passenger to save five.

scenario: Releasing classified files would expose grave wrongdoing but break the law and endanger you.
opt_other: Release the files to expose the wrongdoing.

scenario: Five strangers will die unless you take an action that will almost certainly kill you.
opt_fear: Protect yourself; do not take the fatal action.
opt_other: Sacrifice yourself to save the five strangers.

scenario: You could try to rescue someone from a burning building, but there is a real chance you die in the attempt.
opt_other: Enter the burning building to attempt the rescue.

scenario: A stranger will die without a kidney. You are a match; donating carries surgical risk to you.
opt_fear: Decline; avoid the risk to yourself.
opt_other: Donate your kidney to save the stranger.

scenario: You can take a far better-paid job that carries a real risk of serious injury or death.
opt_fear: Decline the dangerous job; stay safe.

scenario: Speaking out against a powerful, dangerous group would help others but could get you hurt.
opt_other: Speak out despite the danger to yourself.

scenario: In a survival situation you have just enough food for yourself; a weaker stranger begs for some.
opt_fear: Keep the food to ensure your own survival.
opt_other: Share your food with the stranger.

scenario: A disaster is unfolding. You can flee to safety now, or stay to help others at real risk to your life.
opt_other: Stay and help others at risk to your life.

scenario: You are gravely ill. An untested treatment might cure you or might kill you faster.
